title: Entering results, standings and team statistics
description: Starting a fixture, typing its score, ending it, and reading the standings and team statistics that follow.
body:
Results is where you run the tournament. Each fixture is a card, and each card has three states.

Before you start

You need to be the Owner or an Administrator of the tournament. A referee can do this too, if you gave them Allow referee to start and end matches when you added them.

Entering a result

  1. Open your tournament and choose Results. A fixture that has not started reads Scheduled and carries a START button.

  2. Choose START. The card goes Live. START becomes END, and two score boxes appear between the teams.

  3. Type the score. It saves as you type: there is no Save button and no confirmation.

  4. Choose END when the match is over. A trophy marks the winner.

  5. The table above updates itself.

  6. The LEADERBOARD tab ranks the teams and names the leader.

On a padel tournament

  1. The fixtures are grouped under ROUND 1, ROUND 2 and so on, and the standings carry a SCORE column instead of the three goal columns.

  2. Padel also lists the rules for the format you chose.

  3. On the Leaderboard the stat column reads Score, where football reads Goals.

What you will see

Neither START nor END asks you to confirm, and nor does the score. Everything is saved the moment you do it.

A score can still be corrected after you press END. What closes score entry is ending the phase - after that the boxes are gone and the score is plain text. Read Tournament phases - preview, start, end and undo to end a phase.

On a narrow screen the eight standings columns do not fit, and a View Stats control opens them in a panel instead.

If it does not work

  • There are no score boxes. The fixture has not been started. Press START.
  • There is no START button either. The phase has been ended. Nothing can be scored after that.
  • The table has not changed. Give it a moment; it refetches after each score.
  • You entered the wrong score. Type over it. The boxes stay editable until the phase ends.
